items.title: The dimension of the support of a flat finite type sheaf cannot jump above its generic value
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a locally finite type morphism to an irreducible base and a finite type quasi-coherent sheaf flat over the base, the lemma bounds the dimension of the support of every fibre by the dimension of the support of the generic fibre. The proof is a written specialization argument: take a generic point x of an irreducible component of the fibre support, use going-down for flat modules to specialize from a point y over the generic point within the support, and bound the dimension of the closure of x via the associated-point specialization lemma. Retained author proof at lines 5264-5273.
